name: Two-way road: carriageways must not overlap
description: One physical street carrying both directions. The two streams must be drawn side by side with a visible gap. If they sit on top of each other the carriageway offset is not being applied.

lab.expect: One physical street carrying both directions. The two streams must be drawn side by side with a visible gap. If they sit on top of each other the carriageway offset is not being applied.
